mapper.select: SELECT id FROM approval_application WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{applicationId} AND status='APPROVED' AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND version=#{applicationVersion} AND process_key=#{processKey} AND definition_version=#{definitionVersion} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_submission_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND definition_version=#{definitionVersion} AND status='APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signature_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND active_guard=1
mapper.update: UPDATE signature_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},poll_at=#{pollAt},active_guard=#{terminal} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND request_digest=#{digest} AND target_digest=#{targetDigest} AND active_guard=1

UPDATE signature_result_file SET status='READY',saved_at=#{savedAt},saved_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{id} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND content_id=#{contentId} AND byte_size=#{size} AND sha256=#{sha256} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id FROM signature_operation q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=q.round_no WHERE q.poll_at<=#{pollAt} AND q.active_guard=1 ORDER BY q.poll_at,q.tenant_id,q.id LIMIT #{DUE_LIMIT}

SELECT version,state_json,occurred_at FROM signature_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version>#{afterVersion} AND version<=#{version} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM signature_result_file WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{id} AND created_version<=#{version} ORDER BY document_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signature_source_document(tenant_id,operation_id,application_id,round_no,attachment_id,original_content_id,field_path,filename,byte_size,sha256,original_status) SELECT a.tenant_id,#{id},a.application_id,#{roundNo},a.id,COALESCE(a.content_id,a.id),a.field_path,a.filename,a.byte_size,a.sha256,'READY' FROM approval_attachment a JOIN approval_attachment_round r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.application_id=a.application_id AND r.attachment_id=a.id AND r.field_path=a.field_path WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.application_id=#{applicationId} AND r.round_no=#{expectedRoundNo} AND a.id=#{attachmentId} AND COALESCE(a.content_id,a.id)=#{contentId} AND a.field_path=#{fieldPath} AND a.filename=#{filename} AND a.byte_size=#{size} AND a.sha256=#{sha256} AND a.status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT attachment_id,original_content_id,field_path,filename,byte_size,sha256 FROM signature_source_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM signature_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND id=#{argument2}
SELECT * FROM signature_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND id=#{argument2} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM signature_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND application_id=#{argument2} AND round_no=#{argument3} ORDER BY authorized_at,id LIMIT #{argument4}

SELECT * FROM signature_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND application_id=#{argument2} AND round_no=#{argument3} AND (authorized_at>#{argument4} OR (authorized_at=#{argument5} AND id>#{argument6})) ORDER BY authorized_at,id LIMIT #{argument7}
